options.name: cloud_init
options.description: Configuration to be used by cloud-init (Linux) or cloudbase-init (Windows). When non-empty will create an extra ISO device attached to VM as a NoCloud datasource. There has to be cloud-config comment present at the beginning of cloud_init file or raw yaml. The cloud-init configuration is applied only during the initial creation of a VM (whether through provisioning, cloning, or importing). It is not applied to an existing VM. This is consistent with the behavior of the HyperCore appliance.

options.name: preserve_mac_address
options.description: Allows keeping same MAC addresses as in original VM.

options.name: source_snapshot_label
options.description: Allows cloning VM from a specific snapshot using snapshot label.

options.name: source_snapshot_uuid
options.description: Allows cloning VM from a specific snapshot using snapshot uuid.

options.name: source_vm_name
options.description: Name of the source virtual machine, to be cloned. Used to identify selected virtual machine by name.

options.name: tags
options.description: Virtual machine tags. Used to group virtual machine.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the VM clone. Used to identify a clone of the virtual machine by name.
